breakdown.description: The case is declared plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the incorrect constitutive relation. The incomplete prompt specified a plane stress problem but gave the Lamé parameter formula for plane strain (`lambda = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2*nu))`). The agent repeated this exact incorrect formula in the generated specification instead of correcting it to the appropriate plane stress relation, as indicated by the ground truth which states to use the 'reduced plane-stress constitutive law'.
